initial.name: daniel
initial.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 8-bit game sprite strip PNG. Create ONE 1536x512 PNG, a 3:1 horizontal strip of exactly THREE equally sized 512x512 square cells, with a REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background; not white, not a checkerboard drawing. No visible cell borders. The entire canvas other than character pixels must be transparent.
Style: cohesive charming retro old-console 8-bit RPG pixel art. Chunky visibly square pixels, low-resolution design approximating a 64x64 sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor edges. Large head, small body, about 3 heads tall. Uniform dark one-logical-pixel outlines, limited palette, flat pixel color clusters; no antialiasing, gradients, shadows, ground, text, labels, instruments, props, dog, additional characters, scenery, or watermarks.
Layout: same exact character, clothes, skin tone, head size, scale and feet baseline in all three cells. Center at x=256, x=768 and x=1280. Entire character including shoes visible. Each character occupies central 55% of cell width and 82% of cell height. Feet baseline y=461 (90% height), ample transparent padding all around.
POSES, left to right: Cell 1: standing STILL, perfectly FRONT FACING the viewer, symmetrical face showing both eyes, feet together, neutral arms. Cell 2: full RIGHT-FACING PROFILE, nose and toes pointing to the right, WALK CONTACT pose with LEFT leg stepping forward toward right side and RIGHT arm swinging forward, other leg behind. Cell 3: same full RIGHT-FACING PROFILE, WALK OPPOSITE CONTACT pose with RIGHT leg stepping forward toward right side and LEFT arm swinging forward, other leg behind. The second and third poses must be visibly different opposite stride frames, not duplicates. Exactly 3 poses, never a fourth pose.
Subject: DANIEL: stocky white middle-aged man, round friendly face, brown baseball cap, short gray beard, dark green open overshirt over black band T-shirt (reduce graphic to simple pixel shapes with NO text), dark pants and dark shoes. Reference photo role: identity/outfit only, central stocky man in brown cap. Do not copy photo background/layout.

corrective.name: daniel
corrective.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing transparent 3:1 pixel-art game sprite strip. Preserve the first (front-facing) pose and second (right-facing wide stride) pose EXACTLY, unchanged pixels, identity, outfit, scale, location. Replace ONLY the THIRD pose in the rightmost square cell with a clearly different RIGHT-FACING WALK PASSING POSE. Third pose must have feet CLOSE TOGETHER UNDERNEATH THE TORSO, NOT spread wide: near leg straight vertical and planted directly under hip, far leg bent sharply at knee with heel lifted BACKWARD toward the left behind the standing calf. The lifted foot does not touch the ground. Arms swing OPPOSITE the second pose. Nose, face and toes remain pointing RIGHT. This narrow silhouette passing step must look conspicuously different from the second pose's wide stance. For skirt character, show one boot directly under body planted and other boot lifted behind beneath skirt. Preserve character identity, clothing, skin tone, exact head size and scale, pixel-art styling, full-body shoes visible, baseline, and equal 3-cell layout. Preserve REAL transparent alpha around the three poses, never add a background or checkerboard. Keep 3:1 dimensions and exactly three characters, one per cell. No instruments, props, shadows, ground, text, labels, frame lines or extra figures. Output PNG with transparent background. All changes confined to third cell.
